claim: Before optimising hooks in a CPU-paced game, find where the frame is paced; a limiter at that point plus 28 MHz for the work ran very smooth on hardware in one game.

evidence.text: The game frame runs inside the IM2 handler with interrupts off, one per LIMIT = 3 interrupts (the original runs one frame per 3 interrupts, 4 when busy).
evidence.quote: interrupts off, at 28 MHz, one per LIMIT = 3 interrupts (rainbow_islands.md "Pacing").

evidence.text: Frame limiter plus turbo build was very smooth on hardware (minor tearing noted).
